ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark surface with approximately 10-15% area coverage of high-intensity white pixels scattered across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Non-contiguous distribution of high-contrast white micro-blobs and focal spots across the dark background; highest concentration of white pixel clusters is observed on the right lobe and proximal to the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a distinct vertex; calculated internal angle is acute with a bounding-box depth approximately 1/15th of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing edge exhibiting frequent, irregular low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) concentrated on the outer-third of both lobes, isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curvature observed along the outer margins of both lobes, terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, discrete clusters of high-intensity pixels forming roughly circular patterns scattered across the ventral surface, notably on the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible diagonal high-intensity linear streak on the mid-left lobe and several smaller, unaligned linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular clusters of high-intensity, high-relief pixels located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, representing physical accumulations or trauma sites.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density distribution of minute, star-like white punctate spots across the entire visible dark ventral area.
